results.rationale: The balls are duplicated and rearranged into a group, with no basketball resting on a soccer ball. The original soccer ball moves leftward and additional balls alter the composition. A detached black-and-white fragment beside the rear soccer ball creates a clear visual artifact, although the complete balls retain recognizable forms.

The housing, cable and printed labels remain closely matched with slight texture changes. The reading becomes an irregular 118.2-like display rather than approximately 31.7, which the supplied three-degree increase requires. Malformed leftmost segments visibly disrupt the otherwise coherent product image. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
